milestone: Explicit offline local package entry mappings for native CPU modules

implementation.source: Bare named library imports and explicit re-exports select caller-supplied --package name=path.k entries; no implicit search, downloads or registry
implementation.resolution: A flat per-compilation package namespace; mapping paths relative to process working directory, internal relative imports relative to canonical library files; canonical graph identity and original diagnostics retained
implementation.configuration: Compiler/checker share parseModulePackage and loadModules mapping API; duplicate/invalid mappings and unknown names rejected; unused mappings do not load files; count/graph budgets preserved
implementation.safety: All dependency sources protected from output replacement, including symlink/hard-link aliases; requested root extension checked before canonicalization to close a retired-extension symlink bypass
implementation.limits: CPU modules only; manifests, installation, version resolution, lockfiles, independently scoped dependency versions, GPU modules, distributed execution and public native ABI remain separate

coverage: Transitive package imports/reexports and canonical aliases/relative diamonds preserve nominal identity and original function helper scope
Relative mapping entries use process working directory; internal relative modules use the library directory; unused valid mappings do not read missing files
CLI syntax, unknown names, duplicate/invalid mappings, missing used entries, graph cycles/depth/file/mapping counts, original-file diagnostics and GPU placement gate
Checker mappings before/after source; compiler mappings after source; package source output protection and rejected-build output preservation
Six numeric families, String/Bool/nested collection fields, record arrays/maps/captures, fallible calls and retained local workers through named facades
Unchanged ownership harness: malformed input/partial retain failure, cancellation/deadlines/admission/allocator failures, source/scheduler settlement and cached results
Native .k root/import policy and retired root symlink bypass rejection
Two-file documentation compiled and executed in all four variants; existing module/reexport execution and source-protection regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification, not a full-suite or fresh GPU execution claim. Optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses using the existing runtime archive. JS prototype and website are unchanged.
qualification.build_notes: No production edits after final focused qualification began. Existing syntax/module/reexport/semantic frontend tests freshly relinked. Initial frontend/debug package checks passed before final qualification.
